mostWorthwhile.text: Fitting the cradle across the two arches was most worthwhile: it made the purpose of the supports clear and created a place for the tile.

leastWorthwhile.text: Flipping the frame over and upright was straightforward, but the changing names made the text interface slightly harder to follow.

surprise.text: The construction becoming a Whale carrier after fitting the cradle was unexpected; the visible result showed a frame rather than explaining the name.

arbitrary.text: The name Whale carrier felt unexplained, although the actual cradle fitting had a clear purpose.
